parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid, then compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4135, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
